positions.name: PipelineIdGenerationRequirement
positions.frame: how does the pipeline resolve a memory's id when the submission omits one?
positions.why: src-1 states the concrete gap — the submission arrived without an explicit id field — and src-2 states the pipeline's mandatory response to that gap: derive a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback and commit the file. Read together, one directional line runs from absence to required remediation; register and conviction reads support this — src-1 is a flat factual claim while src-2 is decision-grade operational language, but both concern the same id-resolution question, so the tension in conviction level is held rather than resolved.
